title: Let the session that wrote a candidate commit push it as a test ref so remote runners test that exact commit
outcome: Let the session that wrote a candidate commit push it as a test ref so remote runners test that exact commit
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md carry, identically, an author test refs rule matching the wording Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2 concur on in this item's notes: the session that wrote a candidate commit may push exactly that commit to origin as `refs/heads/author-test/<item>-<commit8>` with an explicit refspec, at any stage; never master or another branch, never a force-push, rebase or merge; a run on it counts exactly as the same run from a bundle of that commit would; the pusher deletes only that ref once the run evidence is recorded, at the latest when the item closes.

The candidate-commits wording and `.claude/commands/review-changes.md` no longer say a candidate is never pushed except as the Merger's merge-ready test ref, and the Merger's existing test-ref rule is otherwise unchanged.
The coder test-execution skill tells a coder to hand a remote runner its candidate through such a ref where the project's instructions allow it.

completion.summary: The author test refs rule landed in c6a0784d, on master, together with w-f871 and w-83a7: a coder may push its own candidate as refs/heads/author-test/<item>-<commit8> so remote runners test that exact commit. The run counts as a bundle run, and the pusher deletes only its own ref. The candidate-commits wording, the review-changes command and the coder-test-execution skill point to it. It was later narrowed by ea5252a1 (w-9f7f). The post-landing independent evaluation 677b73c6 passed 4/4.
